remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated residence offering the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and modern living in the heart of Greenwich. This bright and inviting home features thoughtfully updated bathrooms with clean, contemporary finishes throughout. The living spaces are filled with natural light, offering an open and airy layout that feels both welcoming and functional for everyday living and entertaining. The home is equipped with an EV car charger, adding a level of convenience and efficiency. From the seamless flow of the interior spaces to the abundance of light, this home offers an effortless living experience in a prime location close to town, transportation, and all that Greenwich has to offer. A truly turnkey opportunity with modern upgrades and timeless appeal.
